QuestInfo.name: Mopping Away the Destruction
QuestInfo.0: Everyone's going to pitch in and help rebuild Maple Island, step by step. Go speak with Athena Pierce.
QuestInfo.1: Athena Pierce gave you some tools. Deliver them to your friends on Maple Island. \r\nFind Rondo in Southperry first.
QuestInfo.2: You've delivered some tools to Rondo, who's tidying up the Southperry Harbor.

0.0: The people of Victoria Island have gathered these tools to aid Maple Island. Please, use them well.

yes.0: The others await you on Maple Island.

no.0: Are they too heavy for you?

1.1: Hand me that mop, so I can tidy up this harbor. What, you think I'm too good to clean? We've all got to do our part, pal.

npc.0: Go to Amherst and pass out the tools.

item.0: Hey, weren't you supposed to bring us a tool box?
